_doc: The judgement over the probes' leads, read by console/dev-status/engine_health.py. Key: "<probe id>/<item id>" (the page's address bar shows it after the #, URL-decoded). Value: {"status": "confirmed" | "accepted" | "disproved" | "fixed", "note": "one sentence", "ticket": "KLANG-00000"}. confirmed is red, accepted is grey, disproved and fixed are green. Keys that start with _ are ignored. Filled by the audit of KLANG-00420 and by the fixes after it.
